title: Step cards say how (mockup)
caption: Under the step's name, one line says how to do it: open the Cube, click the old piece, choose Extract and confirm.

title: Step cards say how, desktop (mockup)
caption: The same card on a wide screen: the how line fits on one row, above the milestone link.

title: The rest behind the i (mockup)
caption: The step's other notes sit behind the card's i button, as on the dungeon cards; tap it to read them.

title: Item icons on the Cube card (mockup)
caption: Wisdom Stones and crystals show their item icon next to the count, kept on one line with it.

title: Item icons in dungeon rewards (mockup)
caption: A Sealed Dungeon card's reward line shows the crystal and Wisdom Stone icons by each amount.

title: Item icons on step cards (mockup)
caption: A step card that names an item, like Enhance Stones, shows its icon in the title.
